source_text: Complication rates from meta-analyses range from 1-3% for non-therapeutic neonatal procedures, predominantly minor issues like bleeding or infection, compared to 7% for therapeutic circumcisions in older males, with severe outcomes (e.g., penile amputation) under 0.1%. [150] [108]
